title: Obman-Srenia
description: A mod that allows you to use creative on any server without operator rights!
body:
This mod allows you to use "false creative" on any server. This creative's falsity consists of completely blocking data packets sent to the server. That is, when you run the mod, your client is frozen relative to the server and stops sending data packets to the server, allowing you to use creative, flying, breaking and taking blocks, HOWEVER, all these actions occur exclusively on the client, which means that your actions in "fake creative" are completely invisible to the server and after leaving the server/turning off the mode, all the changes you made will be reset to the state that the server remembered.

To enter "fake creative" press V, and to exit "fake creative" mode press V again.
